source.publication: 2025 IT-40 Full-Year Resident Individual Income Tax Booklet
source.section: PDF page 17 'Do not enter any other types of pension or retirement income on these lines'; PDF pages 19-24, the Line 11 list, has no other code for this income; Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = IRA distribution person 0 20,000.00 + employer plan distribution person 0 15,000.00 + Roth conversion person 0 25,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 44,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 60,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 60,000.00 + 0.00 = 60,000.00. Schedule 2: no deductions; line 12 total = 0.00. IT-40 line 4 = 0.00. Line 5 = 60,000.00 - 0.00 = 60,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 0 x 1,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 nobody 65 or older: 0.00; line 7 total = 1,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 1,000.00. Line 7 = 60,000.00 - 1,000.00 = 59,000.00. Line 8 = 59,000.00 x 0.03 = 1,770.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 1,770.00. No deduction for IRA or plan distributions or a Roth conversion; all are in federal AGI.
